# decentralized.host

> Open-source self-hosted deployment platform and distributed compute mesh. Deploy applications from Git or CLI across independently operated compute nodes.

## Core technologies
- Python (control plane, node agent, CLI)
- FastAPI
- PostgreSQL
- Docker
- Traefik
- Solana (optional, devnet-only node-operator credits)

## Repository layout
- control-plane/ -- FastAPI control plane, scheduler, REST API
- node-agent/ -- runs on each mesh node, builds/runs containers via Docker
- cli/ -- the `dhost` command-line tool
- git-server/ -- real SSH git server, deploys on `git push`
- blockchain/ -- Solana devnet credit system (optional, off by default)
- marketing-site/ -- the public site at decentralized.host
- dashboard/ -- the web console at app.$BASE_DOMAIN
- web/ -- original single-page landing page, still shippable through the mesh as a self-hosting example

## Primary capabilities
- CLI deployment (`dhost ship`) with no local Docker or Git required
- Git-push deployment via a real SSH server
- Multi-node scheduling by live CPU/RAM load
- Deployment snapshots, history, and rollback (SHA-256 content-addressed, no Git)
- Automatic Traefik routing with real Let's Encrypt TLS in production
- Optional Solana devnet credits for node operators

## Documentation
- README.md -- architecture, quick start, full command reference
- DEPLOY.md -- production deployment (real domain, real TLS)
- blockchain/README.md -- Solana devnet credit system
